title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- NO CIRCULAR MOVEMENT

content.rendered: “And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.” (Ezekiel 37: 2)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.Our Focal Scripture speaks of that moment when Ezekiel passed by the dry bones round about. Ezekiel walked around the dry bones; he engaged in a circular movement around the bones. It was not movement that took Ezekiel out of the valley; it was movement that merely saw him come back to where he started from. It was movement without real progress; it was movement that happened in circles.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: the season of walking round and round in circles, is over. The season of movement without progress, is over; the season of efforts without tangible results, is over; the season of activity without output, is over; the season of being seen all over the place with nothing to show for it, is over; the season of moving around within the same boundaries, is over; the season of circular, unproductive movements, is over.Hear me as I hear the Lord: in this season, you will advance on all sides. You will make progress in leaps and bounds. Your season of sweetness and continuous congratulations has just begun; your time for unending good news has just begun. You will be counted among those that are not stagnated in life. You will be counted among those that make giant strides daily; yours will be movement with evident progress.Jesus did not redeem you so that you can be trapped in a circle of movements without progress. Jesus redeemed you so that your life will represent Him here on earth. Jesus did not intend that your life will move without tangible results. You were wired to make progress; you were designed to make impact; you were brought to earth to make a mark; you were designed as one whose activity and movement should yield results.Break away from every cycle of movement without progress. Break away from every cycle of circular movement.Isaiah 54: 3 says: “For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.”Declare With Me: I refuse to move around in circles; my movements must come with progress, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
